nonceProbe: Reply with exactly: PONG-<32 hex chars generated per measurement>
privacyRule: This file is published in the sanitized public mirror, so it carries NO prompt text, NO answer text, NO account identity, NO cookie and NO vault path — only lengths and truncated digests. That property is load-bearing: .brain/ is stripped by scripts/ci/make-public-repo.sh:471 and data/ is stripped at :562, so a measurement kept only in either place is not reviewable by anyone reading the repo. Keep it that way.
honestyRule: `class` is ALWAYS the output of classifyOutcome() in src/prompt/verification-class.ts, re-derived by the gate from the machine fields below; a hand-typed class that disagrees with the derivation is a build failure. A row counts as MEASURED — the only thing that may back a published `verified` claim — in ONE OF TWO ARMS, both narrow on purpose. CHAT: provenance === 'harness' AND probeNonceMatched === true AND class === 'ANSWERS' AND a 2xx AND answerChars > 0 AND doneReason === 'stable' AND measuredAt inside the window. CAPABILITY: provenance === 'harness' AND class === 'RETURNS-DATA' AND a 2xx AND capabilityOk === true AND a well-formed resultShape whose evidence is either a counted collection whose runner-declared count AGREES with the counted rows at >= 1, or a single POPULATED record where the runner declared no count of zero, AND measuredAt inside the window. An EMPTY result (declared count 0 over 0 counted rows, or a declared zero count anywhere) is a successful measurement of NOTHING and is deliberately NOT MEASURED: it reaches the wire and returns no records, which is not evidence that the surface produces results, and a class that admitted it would let the gate be satisfied by a surface that returns nothing forever. A row with provenance === 'imported' is a real measurement whose provenance is PROSE: it is kept for the record and it backs NOTHING. `evidence`, `prereq` and `notes` are prose and may never be credited as evidence by any gate.
writeSeamNote: Only scripts/audit/record-roundtrip.mjs writes this file, and it does so by POSTing to an ALREADY-DEPLOYED daemon over that daemon's own wire. The read-only service (src/prompt/http.ts) must never write here and must never certify itself. CI cannot run the harness at all (no vault session, no Chrome owner, no browser), which is exactly why daemonCommit and the staleness window are load-bearing rather than decoration.

knownGaps.meaning: Sites whose own capabilities/<id>/metadata.json carries a complete verified receipt (verified.since/evidence/via all non-empty) and whose capabilities/README.md status cell publishes that claim, but for which NO MEASURED row exists in this file. This is not a hand-typed test literal: it is DATA, and the gate asserts exact set equality against the gap it derives from this record plus those two other sources — so a gap APPEARING and a gap being quietly CLOSED are both build failures. Closing one means running scripts/audit/record-roundtrip.mjs against a live daemon, never editing this list.
